name: Blessing of Tinne [Ogham]
body:
The counterpart to the mighty oak, holly seeks to shine forth no matter what the challenge as represented by the tinne ogham.

Prerequisite(s): Ogham Connection or the Ogham-Craobh class feature.

Benefit(s): You may use your Charisma modifier in place of your Constitution modifier when making Constitution checks or Fortitude saves versus environmental effects or attempting to stabilize if reduced to less than 0 hit points.

For every ogham feat you possess beyond this one, you gain a +1 bonus to the aforementioned skill check as well.
